message:
I was rummaging through my closet the other day and stumbled upon my old backpack, the one I filled with all sorts of supplies for emergencies. I remember my kids teasing me, calling me the gloriously over-prepared person. But as I pulled out the extra pair of socks and a flashlight, I felt a little glow of pride. 

Sure, I might have gone a bit overboard, but isn't it nice to know that when the unexpected happens, we have a little something tucked away? A few snacks, some water, and a plan can go a long way. It’s not about being anxious, but rather being ready to embrace whatever comes our way. 

What’s your favorite little preparedness tip?
